title: A — 3ペイン（shadcn/ui）
prompt:

Asset type: high-fidelity desktop application layout proposal for Resume Studio.
Primary request: Design a practical Japanese macOS desktop app for locally editing a resume and career history, with structured fields, WYSIWYG body editing and a generated PDF preview. Show one full application window straight-on filling a wide 16:10 image, with crisp readable Japanese typography. No device frame, no perspective, no marketing website.

Navigation for 基本情報, 学歴・職歴, 免許・資格, 志望動機, 本人希望; career-specific sections 職務要約, 職務経歴, スキル, 自己PR must be reachable when switching documents. Show only relevant section fields instead of every form at once. Basic information has labeled name, furigana, date of birth, document date, address, phone, email and optional photo import. History rows support add, delete, reorder. Rich body text editing offers bold, italic, bullet and numbered lists, undo/redo when applicable. Template selector. Persistent PDF更新 button for MANUAL generation. PDF preview toolbar with previous/next page, 1 / 2, zoom, and a clearly visible amber PDFは更新前の内容です banner. PDF is read-only, never show editable handles on the paper. Export via 書き出す with PDF / TeX一式 and 表示中の書類 / 両方 options in a compact popover or strip. Show a realistic A4 portrait Japanese ruled resume sheet, 2-page navigation, photo placeholder without any real person. Separate 未保存の変更 from PDFは更新前の内容です. Saving is explicit; never imply autosave or automatic PDF refresh. Environment diagnosis in secondary settings, not the main form. All data is fictional: 山田 花子, やまだ はなこ, sample@example.test, 架空県サンプル市. Do not invent cloud sync, login, AI generation, onboarding marketing, or collaboration features. Professional usable interface, 14-16px equivalent labels, strong focus indicators, clear hierarchy, restrained colors, narrow borders, ample field width, independent scrolling panes.
Design system: faithfully use shadcn/ui default neutral light theme, zinc/neutral grayscale, white surfaces, near-black primary buttons, pale muted backgrounds, thin #e4e4e7 borders, 6px rounded corners, subtle shadows only for dropdowns, compact 36px controls, 14px Japanese sans-serif body typography. Lucide-style 16px outline icons. NOT colorful primary buttons, no blue or green accent. Visually recognizable shadcn Button default / outline / ghost, Input with Label, Select, Tabs with gray TabsList and white active TabsTrigger, Badge outline for 未保存, Separator, Card with CardHeader/CardContent, Alert for stale PDF, DropdownMenu for export. Clearly show 書き出す in top toolbar on EVERY variant. Dropdown options PDF, TeX一式, 表示中の書類, 両方. Template name exactly 標準履歴書 1.2.0, never claim JIS or government compliance. No address lookup, no unsupported body link formatting, no extra mandatory fields. UI component names should not appear as labels to end users. Flat front-on screenshot, entire window at 1440x900 equivalent, readable and restrained production desktop app. Mockup only, no code.
Layout A: Three-pane editor built from Sidebar + ResizablePanelGroup + ScrollArea. 200px Sidebar with Resume Studio logo at top, document Tabs 履歴書 / 職務経歴書, SidebarMenu for 基本情報 selected, 学歴・職歴, 免許・資格, 志望動機, 本人希望. Right PDF pane displays Select 標準履歴書 1.2.0, black PDF更新, muted amber Alert PDFは更新前の内容です, page controls 1 / 2, 100%, actual ruled read-only A4 resume. Subtle vertical resize handles between panes.
